name: Reliquary of Truth
passiveDesc: CRIT Rate is increased by 8/10/12/14/16%. When the equipping character unleashes an Elemental Skill, they gain the Secret of Lies effect: Elemental Mastery is increased by 80/100/120/140/160 for 12s. When the equipping character deals Lunar-Bloom DMG to an opponent, they gain the Moon of Truth effect: CRIT DMG is increased by 24/30/36/42/48% for 4s. When both the Secret of Lies and Moon of Truth effects are active at the same time, the results of both effects will be increased by 50%.
description: An angular box carved from gold and jade. Legend has it that it was once enshrined in a temple deep within Tulaytullah, the Sapphire City.
